title: KYC request
summary: A message asks for identity documents or a verification code through an unexpected route.
scenario: The request uses account suspension or compliance language to obtain sensitive identity data.
warning_signs: Pressure to send a document immediately
safe_actions: Do not upload identity documents through an unverified link
Open the known provider app or site directly
Ask why the information is required before sharing it
recovery_guidance: Contact the provider if documents were disclosed
Watch for further account or identity misuse
reporting_guidance: Keep the request and any submission record
prevention_tips: Minimize documents shared and redact where appropriate
false_positive_notes: Organizations may perform KYC, but the request should be traceable to an independently verified service.
